task.shortdesc: You can access a motor’s information page either through the Motors page or the List

context.p: You can access a motor’s information page either through the Motors page or the List View on the Dashboard page. The following procedure describes how to access a motor’s information page through the Motors page.
To access a motor’s information page:

step.cmd: Log in to the SMS mobile application.
Tap Motors on the bottom menu.
Select the corresponding location associated with the motor.

fig.title: Locations page on the SMS mobile app

step.cmd: From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding plant, process, and motor name.

result.p: Figure Plants, Processes, and Motors pages on the SMS mobile app
The motor’s information page is displayed.

fig.title: Motor information page on the SMS mobile app
